name: SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce
author: Suresh Dindorkar

sections.description:
SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store owners clearly display important product information such as COD availability, return/exchange availability, return period, and shipping status directly on the product page.

The plugin provides simple product-level controls and customizable images for communicating these options to customers.

Features

  • Display COD Available or No COD information.
  • Display Return/Exchange Available or No Return/Exchange information.
  • Display the return period in days when returns are available.
  • Display Free Shipping or Shipping Charges status on product pages.
  • Customize the images used for each information status.
  • Configure information separately for individual products.
  • Display product information clearly on WooCommerce single product pages.
  • Show COD, Return, and Shipping status in the WooCommerce product list.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Lightweight and focused on product information display.

Usage

After activation:

  1. Go to Settings > SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce to configure the images.
  2. Open any WooCommerce product for editing.
  3. Configure the available product information.
  4. If Return/Exchange is enabled, specify the return period in days.
  5. Save the product.
  6. The selected information is displayed on the single product page.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the soswoo-product-info-display-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce.
  4. Go to Settings > SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce.
  5. Add your preferred image URLs for the different information statuses.
  6. Edit a WooCommerce product and configure its COD, Return/Exchange, Return Period, and Shipping status.
  7. Save the product and view the product page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. SosWoo Product Info Display for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I specify a return period?

Yes. When Return/Exchange is enabled for a product, you can specify the return period in days.

Can I customize the information images?

Yes. The plugin allows you to specify custom image URLs for the different product information statuses.

Does the Free version add shipping charges to the cart or checkout?

No. The Free version only displays the shipping status on the product page. It does not add shipping charges to WooCommerce cart or checkout totals.

Does the Free version disable Cash on Delivery at checkout?

No. COD functionality in the Free version is display-only. It does not modify or disable the WooCommerce COD payment gateway.

Can I upgrade to the Premium version?

Yes. The Premium version provides additional WooCommerce product information and advanced pricing-related functionality.

Before installing the Premium version, deactivate the Free version. Existing product settings are preserved when switching from the Free version to the Premium version.
